تستهدون (form X)
# تَسْتَهْدُونَ (tastahdūna) /tas.tah.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# تُسْتَهْدَوْنَ (tustahdawna) /tus.tah.daw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
